rationale: PII is opt-in. Every accepted cell compares PII on against PII off in the same artifact, so the cost is paid only by a caller that enables PII. PII-on absolute time at 8b6a5fd fell to 0.05-0.17 of 8f97f14d on every surface except the CLI (0.67-0.88), and the Chromium diagnostic of benchmarks #428 (runs 36587938904 and 36589203421) found no PII-on absolute-time regression against 8f97f14d: initialize is unchanged, and the official-order incremental slowdown disappears in steady state and with the Wasm tier pinned (TurboFan-only or Liftoff-only), where 8b6a5fd is 13-42 percent faster. The size rows are the accepted Beta.11 PII payload (#937 split, #902 association). Accepted for this candidate and these official runs only (bound candidate run 36584501052; the second candidate run 36585713241 is recorded as not used); nothing is excluded. Any later breach, at another commit or run, is judged afresh.

benefit.summary: Beta.11 ships six opt-in PII families (network-address, email, payment-card, IBAN, US SSN, NANP phone) under pii-context/v2, with linear-time context association (#902, #996) that cut PII-on whole-input time by 6-20x against 8f97f14d.

decidedBy: milocosmopolitan (maintainer decision of 2026-09-29 accepting the remaining Beta.11 PII profile-cost cells and size rows at 8b6a5fd as a tradeoff, excluding any cell the Chromium diagnostic shows to be a real PII-on absolute-time regression; relayed by the Beta.11 orchestrator)
